optionReasons.saa-ini-091:option:0: Major cases AUMENTAM the cost — and remain idle at dawn.
optionReasons.saa-ini-091:option:1: RI for capacity of PICO pays discount on idle capacity all night long — waste continues.
optionReasons.saa-ini-091:option:3: Disabling monitoring saves cents and blinds operation — does not attack computer waste.

finalJustifications: Because Auto Scaling aligns capacity and cost to real demand: fewer instances in the morning, more at peaks — only what is needed at each moment is paid.
Because Auto Scaling negotiates lower rates with AWS in periods of low, passing the economy of idle capacity.
Because Auto Scaling hibernates the entire site out of business hours, restoring the memory of the instances in the morning.
Because Auto Scaling migrating the instances to Spot at dawn, returning to On-Demand before traffic returns.

optionReasons.saa-ini-095:option:0: Dedicated Hosts are the MAIS CAROS — are used for licenses/compliance, not for failure tolerant batch.
optionReasons.saa-ini-095:option:2: RI of 3 years compromises fixed capacity — variable night yield does not need this and the discount is lower than that of the Spot.
optionReasons.saa-ini-095:option:3: On-Demand pays full fare — tolerance to load interruption allows capture up to 90% discount no Spot.

finalJustifications: Because interrupting tolerant loads are the perfect case of Spot: until 90% of discount, and the interrupted picture only returns to the row and is reprocessed.
Because Spot Fleet ensures that no instance will be interrupted during the set performance night window.
Because Spot includes free access to rendering GPUs, the hardware that dominates the cost of a typical farm rendering.
Because Spot it only collects by the pictures rendered successfully, exempting the lost time with interruptions of the AWS.

optionReasons.saa-ini-096:option:1: RI gives discount, but keeps the charge 24/7 — turn off the ~128h idle saves more.
optionReasons.saa-ini-096:option:3: Replicate in another region DOBRA the cost — the opposite of the objective.

finalJustifications: Because stopped instance does not generate computer cost: turn off dev/homolog at night and on short weekends ~70% of the cost without affecting the team.
Because automatic shutdown also erases volumes and zeros the storage cost along with the computer cost.
Because disconnected instances continue to meet requests in economic mode, with CPU reduced and lower rate.
Because the AWS grants 70% discount for instances with scheduled registration in the Official Scheduler Forum of the account.

optionReasons.saa-ini-135:option:0: It's changed: the C family is for CPU intensive (video) and memory R (in-memory bank) — not the opposite.
optionReasons.saa-ini-135:option:1: General use for everything ignores the profiles: the in-memory bank would run out RAM and the video without CPU.
optionReasons.saa-ini-135:option:3: I/D families optimize DISCO local — none of the three loads is limited by storage I/O.

finalJustifications: Because the R family (high memory/vCPU) serves the in-memory bank, the C (high memory/vCPU) CPU) video processing, and T/M the balanced web server.
Because the R family includes dedicated GPUs that accelerate the large data sets of the in-memory bank in RAM.
Because the T and M families are the only ones approved for web servers — the others refuse traffic HTTP by default.
Because the C family brings local NVMe storage, the actual requirement of intensive cluster video processing.

optionReasons.saa-ini-144:option:0: The Logs Insights consults LOGS — does not analyze metrics of use nor recommends types of instance.
optionReasons.saa-ini-144:option:2: The config audit conforms configuration — does not perform sizing analysis.
optionReasons.saa-ini-144:option:3: The Cost Explorer has basic rightsizing recommendations, but the ML tool dedicated to CPU/memory/network with type recommendation is the Optimizer Computer.

finalJustifications: Because the Computer Optimizer analyzes with ML the historical metrics CloudWatch (CPU, memory, network) and recommends the types of instance appropriate to the real profile.
Because Computer Optimizer automatically changes the instance types at night, applying the recommended profile without downtime.
Because Computer Optimizer is based on tags and the name of the features to infer the proper sizing of each one.
Because Computer Optimizer requires a paid agent installed in each instance to collect metrics beyond the CloudWatch.

optionReasons.saa-ini-156:option:0: A AMI catch DISCO, no RAM — when starting, the application would rebuild the state of zero.
optionReasons.saa-ini-156:option:2: Spot is the opposite: it can be INTERROMPIDA and does not preserve memory.
optionReasons.saa-ini-156:option:3: Auto Recovery recreates the instance after hardware failure — the RAM is lost in the process.

finalJustifications: Because EC2 Hibernate records RAM No volume EBS root when stopping and restoring in startup — the 'hot' state returns exactly as it was.
Because the Hibernate keeps the RAM energized in the physical host while the instance is stopped, charging only the memory.
Because the Hibernate replicates the memory to the S3 continuously restoring the hot state from the last snapshot.
Because Hibernate converts the instance into serverless function during the pause, keeping the state in the runtime managed.

optionReasons.saa-ini-182:option:1: On-demand with Auto Scaling gives elasticity, but pays TARIFA CHEIA — is not the biggest discount.
optionReasons.saa-ini-182:option:2: Dedicated Mechanisms cost MAIS by isolated hardware — the opposite of minimizing cost.
optionReasons.saa-ini-182:option:3: RI of 3 years gives lower discount than Spot and compromises fixed capacity for a load that tolerates interruption.

finalJustifications: Because Spot uses idle capacity of AWS up to ~90% discount and warning of 2 minutes — ideal for night lot with independent and retreadable tasks.
Because Spot blocks interruptions during scheduled windows, protecting the night lot from capacity recovery.
Because Spot it charges per task completed instead of per hour, exempting the time of the instances interrupted by the AWS.
Because Spot includes network priority to transfer videos, accelerating the upload of rendered frames to S3.

optionReasons.saa-ini-192:option:0: Spot is not a guaranteed discount commitment — is interruptible idle capacity.
optionReasons.saa-ini-192:option:2: Standard RIs arrest type/family — break precisely with M5 → M6g migration.
optionReasons.saa-ini-192:option:3: EC2 Forum Savings Plans give greater discount, but PRESOS to a family and region — without the required flexibility.

finalJustifications: Because the Computer Savings Plans commits expenditure USD/time for 1-3 and applies the discount to any family/size/SO/region of EC2, more Fargate and Lambda.
Because the Computer Savings Plans allows you to cancel the commitment at any time, keeping the discount proportional to the use.
Because the Computer Savings Plans doubles the discount to each annual renewal, rewarding the fidelity to the commitment of spending.
Because the Computer Savings Plans covers also banks RDS and clusters Redshift, unifying the entire account discount.
